questions._flag: CBSE key is (D) radius of the coil, kept. Re-derivation agrees that the field inside a long solenoid (B = μ0 n I) does not depend on the radius, but it also does not depend on the DIRECTION of the current, which only reverses the field: (B) is equally defensible for a question about the field's 'strength'.
